assets.name: Mara
assets.description: Woman in her 60s; wiry build; grey-streaked braid; oil-stained work jacket; carries a brass locket; hurried, breathless at the pier.

assets.name: Jonas
assets.description: Man in his 60s; broad-shouldered; wears a flat cap; sits alone in the ferry cabin.

assets.name: Harbour Pier
assets.description: Exterior; deserted wooden pier with planks; wind and sea spray; dusk; a ferry with blazing lights idles at the far end.

assets.name: Ferry Cabin
assets.description: Interior of the ferry; warm tungsten light; rows of empty benches; spray-streaked windows looking out on the pier; dusk.

assets.name: Brass locket
assets.description: Brass locket that opens; held in Mara's hand, handed to Jonas, who opens it.

assets.name: Ferry
assets.description: A single passenger ferry with its lights blazing; idles at the end of the pier; sounds its horn as it departs.

assets.name: Mara (voice)
assets.description: Woman in her 60s; breathless and pleading at first, then dry and tender.

assets.name: Ferryman (voice)
assets.description: Off-screen man calling loudly over the wind; urgent.
